definitions.explanation: The combined crime of offering and accepting bribes. Covers both sides of bribery — the person giving the bribe and the official receiving it.

examples.japanese: {贈収賄|ぞうしゅうわい}で{逮捕|たいほ}された。
{贈収賄|ぞうしゅうわい}{事件|じけん}が{大|おお}きなニュースになった。
examples.english: The bribery case became big news.

examples.japanese: {市長|しちょう}が{贈収賄|ぞうしゅうわい}の{容疑|ようぎ}で{取|と}り{調|しら}べを{受|う}けている。
examples.english: The mayor is being investigated on suspicion of bribery.

notes:
A compound of {贈|ぞう} (giving) + {収|しゅう} (receiving) + {賄|わい} (bribe). The word covers both {贈賄|ぞうわい} (offering a bribe) and {収賄|しゅうわい} (accepting a bribe) as a single concept.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {贈収賄|ぞうしゅうわい}{事件|じけん}: bribery case/scandal
- {贈収賄|ぞうしゅうわい}の{容疑|ようぎ}: suspicion of bribery
- {贈収賄|ぞうしゅうわい}で{起訴|きそ}される: to be indicted for bribery
- {贈収賄|ぞうしゅうわい}{罪|ざい}: the crime of bribery

RELATED WORDS:
- {贈賄|ぞうわい}: giving a bribe — the crime committed by the bribe-giver
- {収賄|しゅうわい}: accepting a bribe — the crime committed by the official
- {賄賂|わいろ}: bribe — the money or goods exchanged
- {汚職|おしょく}: corruption — broader term for official misconduct
